meta.title: Tiago AI · Interview Tiago Kochem, even when he's offline
meta.description: An open source agentic AI digital twin. Ask about Tiago Kochem's experience and projects by chat, voice or WhatsApp. Grounded answers with sources.

hero.subtitle: Tiago AI is my digital twin. It answers recruiters' questions about my experience and projects, cites every source, and hands sensitive topics over to the real me.
hero.note: Answers come only from my résumé, projects and website. No sources, no claim.

features.title: Grounded answers
features.body: Hybrid RAG (pgvector + full-text, fused with RRF) over a bilingual knowledge base. Every claim links to its source.

features.title: A real agent, not a prompt
features.body: A LangGraph state machine guards, routes, retrieves, grades relevance, rewrites the query when needed and streams the answer.

features.title: Knows when to call me
features.body: Salary, offers and scheduling go straight to my WhatsApp with a summary of the conversation. It never makes things up.

flow.title: What happens when you ask a question
flow.subtitle: Open the agent trace in the interview to watch each step, with latency, tokens and cost.

engineering.title: Built like a production AI system

items.title: Measured RAG
items.body: 50-question bilingual golden set; hit@k, MRR and LLM-judged faithfulness run in CI.

items.title: Resilient
items.body: OpenAI primary with automatic DeepSeek fallback; degrades to full-text search if embeddings fail.

items.title: Observable
items.body: Latency, tokens and cost recorded per graph node, plus optional Langfuse tracing.

items.title: Safe
items.body: Prompt-injection guard, rate limits, per-session budgets, keys only on the backend.

footer.built: Built by Tiago Kochem with FastAPI, LangGraph, PostgreSQL/pgvector and Next.js.
footer.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. For anything important, talk to Tiago directly.

interview.title: Interview
interview.ended: Interview ended. Tiago received a summary. Thank you!
